title: Nvidia Backs Firmus AI Cloud Deal
title_zh: Nvidia 支持 Firmus 人工智能云交易
summary: The partnership will give smaller AI companies access to Nvidia-powered computing.
summary_zh: 此次合作将使小型人工智能公司能够使用 Nvidia 驱动的计算。

title: Danaher (DHR) Completes $9.9B Acquisition of Masimo Corporation
title_zh: 丹纳赫 (DHR) 完成 $9.9B 收购 Masimo Corporation
summary: Danaher Corporation (NYSE:DHR) is one of the best long term stocks to buy according to hedge funds. On June 10, Danaher completed its acquisition of Masimo Corporation, a specialist in pulse oximetry and patient monitoring solutions.
summary_zh: 根据对冲基金的说法，丹纳赫公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：DHR）是最值得购买的长期股票之一。 6 月 10 日，丹纳赫完成了对脉搏血氧饱和度和患者监测解决方案专家 Masimo Corporation 的收购。

title: Did Salesforce Just Figure Out How to Beat the "SaaSpocalypse" With Its New Acquisition? Shares Are an Incredible Bargain If It Did.
title_zh: Salesforce 是否刚刚弄清楚如何通过其新收购来击败“SaaS 末日”？如果确实如此，那么股票就是一个令人难以置信的便宜货。
summary: Salesforce's new acquisition has figured out how to win in the age of agentic AI.
summary_zh: Salesforce 的新收购已经找到了如何在代理人工智能时代获胜的方法。

title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。

title: KKR (KKR) Eyes $1 Billion Plus Medicover Hospitals India Deal
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 着眼于印度 10 亿美元加医疗保险医院交易
summary: KKR is reported to be in advanced talks to acquire a majority stake in Medicover Hospitals India. The potential deal could be valued at more than $1b and would expand KKR's healthcare platform in India.
summary_zh: 据报道，KKR 正在就收购印度 Medicover Hospitals 多数股权进行深入谈判。这笔潜在交易的价值可能超过 10 亿美元，并将扩大 KKR 在印度的医疗保健平台。
